_comment: OPTIONAL nudge hooks — DISABLED BY DEFAULT. Enable by moving this file to your Claude Code settings hooks section. The PreToolUse matcher targets Claude Code's dedicated Grep tool (not Bash grep) — matcher drift is a known failure mode; verify matcher names against your Claude Code version before enabling.

hooks.command: echo '[batho nudge] For structural questions (who calls, dependencies, impact), prefer Batho graph tools (search_entities, get_entity, trace_path) before grep. Exact-string search is fine with grep.' >&2; exit 0
